description: This Java class defines the behavior for key press effects in the AnySoftKeyboard Android keyboard app, including sound, vibration, and key preview management.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardPressEffects
classes.description: Abstract class managing key press effects such as sound, vibration, and key previews in the AnySoftKeyboard Android keyboard app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes audio, vibration, and subscribes to various observable streams for managing sound and vibration effects.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Updates internal state regarding password input when input view starts.

methods.name: onThemeChanged
methods.description: Handles theme changes, triggering recreation of key preview controller.

methods.name: onCreateInputView
methods.description: Creates input view and triggers key preview controller update.

methods.name: createKeyPreviewController
methods.description: Creates and returns a key preview controller based on user preferences and input context.

methods.name: performKeySound
methods.description: Plays a sound effect corresponding to the pressed key.

methods.name: performKeyVibration
methods.description: Triggers vibration for key press, handling exceptions gracefully.

methods.name: onPress
methods.description: Handles key press events, triggering sound and vibration.

methods.name: onText
methods.description: Handles text input events, triggering sound and vibration.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, completes observables, and unloads sound effects.

methods.name: onLongPressDone
methods.description: Triggers vibration for long press events.
